name: @ruviform/ui-viz
description: Issue #260: framework-neutral Reference Viz renderers — Waveform/Meter/Spectrum scene builders, VizStyle paint contract, Canvas2D/WebGL2 backends with declared capabilities and fallback, and Custom Element surfaces (rvf-waveform/rvf-meter/rvf-spectrum). Plain TypeScript + Web Platform APIs; no UI framework, renderer, or data-processing dependency (LOD/FFT stay in ruviform-viz).
